description:
“Casual name, great product!” It’s a good thing that we have a sense of humor! We found that a lot of our patients wanted something “natural”.

With all that in mind, we did some research into natural pharmacologic agents, reading through the available literature (both scientific and non-scientific), talking to numerous other health care professionals from a number of disciplines, and most importantly, talking directly to nausea sufferers. We discovered which herbs are truly helpful, and developed flavors that would be appealing to anyone with a queasy stomach.

As healthcare professionals, we have dedicated our life’s work to helping people in need. Our friends in the field have welcomed our natural products as an alternative therapy for their patients, and the feedback has been great! From traditional practitioners to the holistic and wellness communities, there seems to be a universal market for a flavorful and simple remedy that makes life a little easier during nauseous times. We are thrilled to offer our customers a tasty way to ease their nausea and help them through difficult times.

Enjoy & Feel Better!!

bullet_point: [Oraganic Sugaring Paste, Soft Grade - Great for Legs, Arms and Armpits, Made in Florida, USA, Ships same day., Easy to use, easy application and hair removal. Washed off with water.]
description:
BEFORE SUGARING
Test Sugar Paste on small area of your skin, hand or leg. It is absolutely normal for skin to be red after sugaring. Please read following Sugaring hair removal technique to make your sugaring session easy and pleasant. Try to exfoliate 1-2 days before planned sugaring session – this will help a lot.


Step 1
1) Put the sugar paste in the microwave with the lid/cover on.

Step 2
Microwave for 15-25 seconds if you have a 35oz Jar and 7-10 seconds if you have 8oz Jar, until the paste is just slightly warmer than room temperature (30-32°C/86-90°F).


Step 3
Check if the sugar paste became pliable.
Tip: Try NOT to make the sugar paste too soft because it is more difficult to work with softer paste.


Step 4
Take the sugar paste from the jar using only the tips of your four fingers.


Step 5
Slowly stretch the paste out over your skin by pulling it AGAINST the direction of hair growth.

How to do Sugaring

Step 6
QUICKLY pull the sugar off in a flicking motion, WITH the direction of hair growth along your skin.
Tip: Don’t pull up/out — pull along. You want to slide out the hairs in their natural direction of growth. Hold your skin REALLY tight with your other hand before you pull. This will make the process less painful lessening the chance of skin irritation.
Normally, the paste flicks right off, but if you use it too long, it can get “gooey” or “melty” and just stick to your skin. Once the paste gets to this point, you can’t use it any more. To get it off take a new piece of sugar out of the jar and stretch it over that melty strip. Flick that off in the normal way, then throw it away and continue with a completely new ball of sugar.

You will most often inhale hypertonic saline as a mist twice a day through a nebulizer. description: The bladder is a hollow muscular organ that is located in the pelvis. The Gallbladder has two functions: one is to store urine and the other is to release/expel urine. Urine drains from the kidneys (one on each side of the body), down the ureters (one on each side of the body), and into the bladder. The urine is stored in the bladder where it remains until urination. When it is time to urinate, the bladder muscle contracts and the outlet of the bladder and sphincter muscles relax to allow urine to pass through the urethra to leave the body. The bladder and urethra are part of the lower urinary tract, whereas the kidneys and ureters are part of the upper urinary tract. The urine in the bladder is normally free of bacteria (sterile). However, bacteria may be present in the bladder but not cause inflammation or symptoms of an infection. Available both in liquid and capsule version.

Alginate is a natural derivative of kelp or seaweed. Natural methods from Switzerland
We give our herbs the time they need to grow. But once they have been harvested, we have to work quickly. description: Imperata 10 is designed to inhibit bleeding and is based on Ningxue Tang (Blood Calming Decoction), with agrimony, biota leaves, rehmannia, and imperata. From the traditional viewpoint, bleeding may occur when there is too much heat in the blood, causing the blood to flow "recklessly" and escape the vessels (treated by cooling herbs, such as raw rehmannia, scute and imperata). The blood cooling herbs are combined with hemostatics, such as lotus node, cephalanopolus, and biota leaf. Some herbs are said to have both properties: sophora flower and sanguisorba cool blood and are hemostatic. From the modern viewpoint, basic actions that the hemostatic herbs contribute are: they can shorten bleeding time by promoting the coagulation of platelets at the site of bleeding; they can prevent bleeding from fragile capillaries; and they can inhibit infection and inflammation that leads to vessel leakage and damage (this may correspond, in part, to the cooling action of the herbs). Bleeding occurs secondary to many disorders, including lack of platelets (thrombocytopenia); ulcerative disorders of the intestines, bladder, urethra, or uterus; lung and sinus infections; and menstruation-related disorders due to hormone imbalances or fibroids. While herbal formulas to inhibit bleeding are suitable for eliminating minor bleeding or for limiting more substantial bleeding, ultimately, the disease that causes bleeding must be resolved. Some conditions, like large fibroids, may continue to produce uterine bleeding even with use of the hemostatics.

description:
Heal Force Nasal Irrigation System

A saline Nasal wash or nasal irrigation can help reduce symptoms associated with allergies, sinusitis, and asthma. Nasal washing removes mucus from the nose so medication can be more effective. Rinsing decreases allergens and irritants from the nose and it can even decrease swelling in the nose. The regular use of nasal saline irrigation can also diminish nasal drainage.

- Maximum capacity: 400 ml
- Material (Body): PP/PE
- Material (nozzle): Silica gel

Instruction:
1) Prepare a measuring cup. Fill the cup with 400ml of lukewarm water and one packet of Cleansing Salt (4.5g). Stir well and now we have 500ml 0.9% sodium chloride solution. Remove the nozzle from the top of the irrigation device and pour the solution in. Don't use tap water for nasal irrigation.

2) Lean over (about 45 degrees) and use your mouth to breathe. Gently insert the nozzle into one nostril. Squeeze so the solution can flush in and run out of the other nostril. Repeat the procedure for the other nostril.

3) When nasal congestion is severe, do not squeeze too hard. If you feel the pressure of the nasal cavity or the pressure of inner ear too high, please squeeze gently. Please don’t blow your nose in 5 minutes after nasal irrigation.

4) Wash the nozzle and irrigation device after used.

How Do I Take It?

You will most often inhale hypertonic saline as a mist twice a day through a nebulizer. To ensure that hypertonic saline does not cause problems

  • Empty a single-use vial of hypertonic saline into a clean nebulizer cup.

description: Docusate is known as a 'stimulant laxative'. It acts on nerve endings in the gut wall. These nerves then make the muscles in the intestine contract with more force and more often. When the gut contracts, it moves the contents along faster, and so it reduces constipation. It may also act by softening the stool. The muscle contractions move the feces through the bowel faster, meaning that there is less time for water to be absorbed from the feces in the gut into the blood. As a result, the feces contain more water and are softer and easier to pass. As docusate increases the activity of the muscle in the gut, it often causes stomach cramps. The tablets, taken by mouth, take about 1 to 2 days to work.

אזהרת בטיחות כבד: מוצר זה מכיל אצטמינופן. נזק חמור לכבד עלול להתרחש אם אתה לוקח: יותר מ-4,000 מ"ג של אצטמהופן תוך 24 שעות; עם תרופות אחרות המכילות אצטמינופן; 3 משקאות אלכוהוליים או יותר בכל יום תוך שימוש במוצר זה. התראת אלרגיה: Acetaminophen עלול לגרום לתגובות עור חמורות. התסמינים עשויים לכלול: אדמומיות בעור; שלפוחיות; פריחה. אם מתרחשת תגובת עור, הפסיקו את השימוש ופנו לעזרה רפואית מיד. אין להשתמש: עם כל תרופה אחרת המכילה אצטמינופן (מרשם או ללא מרשם). אם אינכם בטוחים אם תרופה מכילה אצטמינופן, בקשו רופא או רוקח; אם אי פעם הייתה לכם תגובה אלרגית למוצר זה או לכל אחד ממרכיביו. שאל רופא לפני השימוש אם יש לך מחלת כבד. שאל רופא או רוקח לפני השימוש אם אתה לוקח את הדם מדלל סמים Warfarin. הפסיקו את השימוש ושאלו את הרופא אם: הכאב נהיה גרוע או נמשך יותר מ-10 ימים; החום נהיה גרוע יותר או מחזיק יותר מ-3 ימים; מתרחשים תסמינים חדשים; אדמומיות או נפיחות. אלה יכולים להיות סימנים של מצב רציני. אם בהריון או מניקה, יש לשאול איש מקצוע בריאות לפני השימוש. הרחיקו מהישג ידם של ילדים. אזהרת מינון יתר: במקרה של מינון יתר, קבלו עזרה רפואית או צרו קשר מיד עם מרכז בקרת רעלים (1-800-222-1222). טיפול רפואי מהיר הוא קריטי למבוגרים כמו גם לילדים גם אם אינכם מבחינים בסימנים או בתסמינים. מרכיבים מרכיב פעיל (בכל קפסולה): Acetaminophen 500 מ"ג. מטרה: משכך כאבים/חום. מרכיבים לא פעילים: שעוות קרנובה, עמילן תירס, נתרן קרוסקרמלוז, היפרומליז, פוליאתילן גליקול, פובידון, עמילן pregelatinized, נתרן גליקולט, חומצה סטארית. (עשוי להכיל אחד או יותר מהרכיבים האלה). הוראות לא לוקחות יותר מההוראות (ראו אזהרת מינון יתר). מבוגרים וילדים בגילאי 12 ומעלה: קחו 2 כמוסות כל 6 שעות בזמן שהסימפטומים נמשכים; אל תיקחו יותר מ-6 כמוסות תוך 24 שעות, אלא אם כן הוראה על ידי רופא; אין להשתמש במשך יותר מ-10 ימים אלא אם כן הוראות רופא; ילדים מתחת לגיל 12: שאל רופא. מידע נוסף: אחסנו ב-20-25 מעלות צלזיוס. שימושים: מקל באופן זמני על כאבים קלים עקב הצטננות; כאבי ראש; כאבי גב; כאב גב; כאב קל של דלקת פרקים; כאב שיניים; כאבי שרירים; התכווצויות קדם-וסת; מפחית באופן זמני חום.

Sicherheitswarnungen Leberwarnung: Dieses Produkt enthält Acetaminophen. Bei der Einnahme von mehr als 4.000 mg Acetaminophen in 24 Stunden können schwere Leberschäden auftreten, bei anderen Medikamenten, die Acetaminophenhaltigen, 3 oder mehr alkoholische Getränke jeden Tag während der Anwendung dieses Produkts verwenden. Allergiehinweis: Acetaminophen kann schwere Hautreaktionen hervorrufen. Symptome können sein: Hautrötung, Blasen, Ausschlag. Wenn eine Hautreaktion auftritt, verwenden Sie die Anwendung und suchen Sie sofort medizinische Hilfe auf. Nicht verwenden: mit anderen Medikamenten, die Acetaminophen enthalten (verschreibungspflichtig oder nicht verschreibungspflichtig). Wenn Sie sich nicht sicher sind, ob ein Arzneimittel Acetaminophen enthält, fragen Sie einen Arzt oder Apotheker, wenn Sie jemals eine allergische Reaktion auf dieses Produkt oder einen seiner Inhaltsstoffe gefunden haben. Fragen Sie vor der Anwendung einen Arzt, wenn Sie Lebererkrankungen haben. Fragen Sie einen Arzt oder Apotheker vor der Anwendung, wenn Sie das blutverdünnende Arzneimittel Warfarin einnehmen. Stoppen Sie die Anwendung und fragen Sie einen Arzt, wenn Schmerzen verschlimmert werden oder mehr als 10 Tage dauern; Fieber wird schlimmer oder dauert mehr als 3 Tage. Neue Symptome treten auf, Rötungen oder Schwellungen sind vorhanden. Dies könnte Anzeichen für einen schweren Zustand sein. Wenn Sie schwanger sind oder stillen, fragen Sie vor der Anwendung einen Arzt. Außerhalb der Reichweite von Kindern aufbewahren. Überdosierung Warnung: Bei Überdosierung ärztliche Hilfe einholen oder sofort Giftinformationszentrale kontaktieren (1-800-222-1222) Schnelle medizinische Hilfe ist sowohl für Erwachsene als auch für Kinder entscheidend, auch wenn Sie keine Anzeichen oder Symptome bemerken. Inhaltsstoffe Wirkstoff (in jeder Kapsel): Acetaminophen 500 mg Zweck: Schmerzlinderung / Fieberreduktion Inaktive Inhaltsstoffe: Carnaubawachs, Maisstärke, Croscarmellose Natrium, Hypromellose, Polyethylenglykol, Povidon, vorgelatinierte Stärke, Natriumstärkenglykolat, Stearinsäure. (Kann einen oder mehrere dieser Inhaltsstoffe enthalten.) Die Anweisungen nehmen nicht mehr als angegeben ein (siehe Überdosierungswarnung). Erwachsene und Kinder ab 12 Jahren: Nehmen Sie 2 Kapseln alle 6 Stunden ein, während die Symptome anhalten; Nehmen Sie nicht mehr als 6 Kapseln in 24 Stunden ein, es sei denn, von einem Arzt verordnet; Nicht länger als 10 Tage verwenden, es sei denn, von einem Arzt verordnet; Kinder unter 12 Jahren: Fragen Sie einen Arzt. Weitere Informationen: bei 20-25 °C lagern. Anwendungen: Lindert vorübergehend kleine Schmerzen und Schmerzen durch Erkältung, Kopfschmerzen, Rückenschmerzen, leichte Schmerzen von Arthritis, Zahnschmerzen, Muskelschmerzen, prämenstruelle und Menstruationsbeschwerden, reduziert vorübergehend Fieber.

تحذيرات السلامة: يحتوي هذا المنتج على الأسيتامينوفين. قد يحدث تلف شديد للكبد إذا تناول: أكثر من 4000 مجم من الأسيتامينوفين في 24 ساعة؛ مع أدوية أخرى تحتوي على الأسيتامينوفين؛ 3 مشروبات كحولية أو أكثر كل يوم أثناء استخدام هذا المنتج. تنبيه للحساسية: قد يسبب الأسيتامينوفين تفاعلات جلدية شديدة. قد تشمل الأعراض ما يلي: احمرار الجلد؛ التقرحات؛ الطفح الجلدي. في حالة حدوث رد فعل جلدي، توقف عن الاستخدام واطلب المساعدة الطبية على الفور. لا تستخدم: مع أي دواء آخر يحتوي على الأسيتامينوفين (وصفة طبية أو بدون وصفة طبية). إذا لم تكن متأكدًا مما إذا كان الدواء يحتوي على الأسيتامينوفين، فاسأل الطبيب أو الصيدلاني؛ إذا كان لديك أي رد فعل تحسسي لهذا المنتج أو أي من مكوناته. اسأل الطبيب قبل الاستخدام إذا كنت تعاني من مرض الكبد. اسأل الطبيب أو الصيدلاني قبل الاستخدام إذا كنت تتناول دواء وارفارين الخفيف في الدم. توقفي عن الاستخدام واسألي الطبيب إذا كان الألم أسوأ أو يدوم لأكثر من 10 أيام؛ ويصبح الحمى أسوأ أو يستمر لأكثر من 3 أيام؛ تحدث أعراض جديدة، وقد يحدث احمرار أو تورم. يمكن أن تكون علامات على حالة خطيرة. في حالة الحمل أو الرضاعة، اطلبي أخصائي صحي قبل الاستخدام. يُحفظ بعيدًا عن متناول الأطفال. تحذير الجرعة الزائدة: في حالة الجرعة الزائدة، احصل على مساعدة طبية أو اتصل بمركز مكافحة السموم على الفور (1-800-222-122). العناية الطبية السريعة ضرورية للبالغين والأطفال حتى إذا لم تلاحظ أي علامات أو أعراض. المكونات النشطة (في كل كبسولة): أسيتامينوفين 500 ملغ. الغرض: تخفيف الألم/تخفيف الحمى. المكونات غير النشطة: شمع الكرنوبا، نشا الذرة، صوديوم الكروسكارميلوز، هيبروميلوز، بولي إيثيلين جليكول، بوفيدون، نشا بريجيلاتين، جليكول نشا الصوديوم، حمض الستياريك. (قد يحتوي على واحد أو أكثر من هذه المكونات). التعليمات لا تأخذ أكثر من التوجيهات (انظر تحذير الجرعة الزائدة). البالغين والأطفال من سن 12 عامًا فما فوق: تناول كبسولتين كل 6 ساعات بينما تستمر الأعراض ؛ لا تأخذ أكثر من 6 كبسولات في 24 ساعة، ما لم يكن توجيهات الطبيب؛ لا تستخدمه لأكثر من 10 أيام ما لم يكن توجيهات الطبيب؛ الأطفال أقل من 12 عامًا: اسأل الطبيب. معلومات أخرى: يُخزن عند 20-25 درجة مئوية (48-54 درجة فهرنهايت). الاستخدامات: يخفف مؤقتًا من الأوجاع والآلام البسيطة بسبب ما يلي: البرد الشائع؛ الصداع؛ الظهر ؛ ألم بسيط من التهاب المفاصل؛ ألم الأسنان؛ آلام العضلات؛ تشنجات مرحلة ما قبل الدورة الشهرية؛ يقلل من الحمى مؤقتاً.

Avisos de segurança Aviso de fígado: Este produto contém paracetamol. Podem ocorrer danos graves no fígado se você tomar: mais de 4.000 mg de paracetamol em 24 horas; com outros medicamentos contendo paracetamol, 3 ou mais bebidas alcoólicas todos os dias durante o uso deste produto. Alerta de alergia: o paracetamol pode causar reações severas na pele. Os sintomas podem incluir: vermelhidão da pele; bolhas, erupção cutânea. Se ocorrer uma reação na pele, pare de usar e procure ajuda médica imediatamente. Não usar: com qualquer outro medicamento contendo paracetamol (prescrição médica ou sem prescrição). Se você não tem certeza se um medicamento contém paracetamol, pergunte a um médico ou farmacêutico; se você já teve uma reação alérgica a este produto ou a qualquer um dos seus ingredientes. Pergunte a um médico antes de usar se você tiver doença do fígado. Pergunte a um médico ou farmacêutico antes de usar se você estiver tomando o medicamento para escorrer o sangue warfarin. Pare de usar e pergunte a um médico se: A dor piora ou dura mais de 10 dias; a febre fica pior ou dura mais de 3 dias; ocorrem novos sintomas; vermelhidão ou inchaço está presente. Estes podem ser sinais de uma condição séria. Se estiver grávida ou amamentando, pergunte a um profissional de saúde antes de usar. Mantenha fora do alcance das crianças. Aviso de sobredosagem: em caso de sobredosagem, procure ajuda médica ou entre em contato com um centro de controle de veneno imediatamente (1-800-222-1222). A rápida atenção médica é fundamental para adultos e para crianças, mesmo que você não perceba sinais ou sintomas. Ingredientes: Ingrediente ativo (em cada cápsula): Paracetamol 500 mg. Finalidade: analgésico/redutor de febre. Ingredientes inativos: cera de carnaúba, amido de milho, croscarmelose de sódio, hipromelose, polietilenoglicol, povidona, amido pré-gelatinado, glicolato de sódio, ácido esteárico. (podem conter um ou mais desses ingredientes). Instruções não tomar mais do que as indicações (veja aviso de overdose). Adultos e crianças a partir de 12 anos: Tome 2 cápsulas a cada 6 horas enquanto os sintomas durarem; não tome mais de 6 cápsulas em 24 horas, a menos que seja direcionado por um médico; Não use por mais de 10 dias, a menos que indicado por um médico; Crianças menores de 12 anos: Pergunte a um médico. Outras informações: Armazenar em 20-25 °C (20-25 °C). Usos: alivia temporariamente pequenas dores devido a: resfriado comum; dor de cabeça; dor nas costas; dor menor de artrite; dor de dente; dores musculares; cãibras pré-menstruais e menstruais; reduz temporariamente a febre.

bullet_point: [Oraganic Sugaring Paste, Soft Grade - Great for Legs, Arms and Armpits, Made in Florida, USA, Ships same day., Easy to use, easy application and hair removal. Washed off with water.]
description:
BEFORE SUGARING
Test Sugar Paste on small area of your skin, hand or leg. It is absolutely normal for skin to be red after sugaring. Please read following Sugaring hair removal technique to make your sugaring session easy and pleasant. Try to exfoliate 1-2 days before planned sugaring session – this will help a lot.


Step 1
1) Put the sugar paste in the microwave with the lid/cover on.

Step 2
Microwave for 15-25 seconds if you have a 35oz Jar and 7-10 seconds if you have 8oz Jar, until the paste is just slightly warmer than room temperature (30-32°C/86-90°F).


Step 3
Check if the sugar paste became pliable.
Tip: Try NOT to make the sugar paste too soft because it is more difficult to work with softer paste.


Step 4
Take the sugar paste from the jar using only the tips of your four fingers.


Step 5
Slowly stretch the paste out over your skin by pulling it AGAINST the direction of hair growth.

How to do Sugaring

Step 6
QUICKLY pull the sugar off in a flicking motion, WITH the direction of hair growth along your skin.
Tip: Don’t pull up/out — pull along. You want to slide out the hairs in their natural direction of growth. Hold your skin REALLY tight with your other hand before you pull. This will make the process less painful lessening the chance of skin irritation.
Normally, the paste flicks right off, but if you use it too long, it can get “gooey” or “melty” and just stick to your skin. Once the paste gets to this point, you can’t use it any more. To get it off take a new piece of sugar out of the jar and stretch it over that melty strip. Flick that off in the normal way, then throw it away and continue with a completely new ball of sugar.

New Zealand’s Greenshell Mussel (Green Lipped Mussel)
The planktons that grow naturally in the seas of New Zealand have undergone unique evolution in reaction to the strong Ultraviolet rays. Greenshell Mussels feed on this plankton, and have been proven to contain substances that are not usually found in mussels grown in other areas – namely Omega unsaturated fatty acid which has anti-inflammatory and anti-oxidative properties.
The Origin of New Zealand Green Lipped Mussel research:
During a research that studied the occurrence of arthritis in the Maori population of New Zealand it was found that the occurrence differed quite markedly between Maori populations of different regions. The populations which had the least occurrences were living close to the beach and consumed large amounts of Greenshell Mussel, while the populations with greater occurrence of arthritis were living inland, further away from the beach, and therefore consumed much less Greenshell Mussel. This medication is not usually used for ongoing coughs from smoking, asthma, other long-term breathing problems (e.g., emphysema), or coughs with a lot of mucus unless directed by your doctor. Do not use this product to make a child sleepy. Do not give other cough-and-cold medication that might contain the same or similar ingredients (see also Drug Interactions section). description:
Main Ingredients of US Clinicals StrongJoint


[Collagen Type II]

Collagen is a natural protein and the primary substance of the connective tissue that holds our body together. It is the main component of skin, cartilage, ligaments, and tendons. However after age of 25, our body’s natural production of collagen starts to reduce at the rate of 1.5% per year. Taking collagen supplements can help to replenish lost collagen, improve mobility, and support overall joint health.

Why Collagen Type II?
There are more than 25 types of collagen that naturally occur in the body. Scientific studies show that Collagen Type II is found to be the predominant type of collagen in the human articular cartilage. It makes up 50% of all the proteins in our cartilage and 85-90% of collagen in our articular cartilage.

Studies show that Collagen Type II has multiple protective benefits to our joint. It helps to:
1. Resist cartilage protein digesting enzymes
2. Reprogram destructive chondrocytes to lessen inflammation
3. Promote new cartilage and proteoglycan synthesis
4. Enhance production of HA, producing a thick, effective, lubricating synovial fluid that protects and cushions joints
5. Protect the surface of cartilage from oxidative (free radical) damage and enzymatic digestion
6. Act as powerful anti-inflammatory/pain modulators.


Other Ingredients 1. BosPure Boswellia Serrata, AKBA 2. MSM (Methylsulfonylmethane) 3. Glucosamine Sulphate 4. Chondroitin Sulphate 5. Hyaluronic Acid 6. Vitamin C 7. Vitamin D 8. Bio-2 9. Goji Berry 10. Manganese

(2) Get your inhaler ready to use by placing drops of the essential oil/s you are going to be using. For this, pour

necessary amount of essential oil/s into the funnel-shaped end of inhaler's tube.

(3) Use 2-4 drops of essential oil/s for adults and 1-2 drops for children under 10 years old.

(4) Recommended duration of inhalation procedure is 4-5 minutes for adults and 1-2 minutes for children.

(5) Repeat the above procedure in 2-4 hours, or in 1-2 hours if necessary. You can inhale both through the nostrils and the mouth.

(6) Take a small rest after the procedure is complete. Avoid eating and drinking for 40-60 minutes following the procedure.

(7) Undergo the procedure until no symptoms of asthma arise. Recommended duration of the course should not exceed 30 days, with 10 to 14 days break in between the procedure courses.

(8) Undergo inhalation once a day as a preventive measure for acute respiratory viral infections (ARVI).

In case you have leftovers of the essential oil/s after inhalation, after completing the procedure firmly close the hole with a cork to avoid evaporation.

Treat your inhaler with ethyl alcohol solution and rinse with warm running water before using it by another person.

description: Diphenhydramine is an antihistamine used to relieve symptoms of allergy, hay fever and the common cold. These symptoms include rash, itching, watery eyes, itchy eyes/nose/throat, cough, runny nose and sneezing. It is also used to prevent and treat nausea, vomiting and dizziness caused by motion sickness. Diphenhydramine can also be used to help you relax and fall asleep. This medication works by blocking a certain natural substance (histamine) that your body makes during an allergic reaction. Its drying effects on such symptoms as watery eyes and runny nose are caused by blocking another natural substance made by your body (acetylcholine). Cough-and-cold products have not been shown to be safe or effective in children younger than 6 years. Therefore, do not use this product to treat cold symptoms in children younger than 6 years unless specifically directed by the doctor. Some products (such as long-acting tablets/capsules) are not recommended for use in children younger than 12 years. Ask your doctor or pharmacist for more details about using your product safely.

When nature calls, don’t let an itchy, uncomfortable rash slow you down! Tecnu Original Outdoor Skin Cleanser is a unique poison ivy soap designed to remove the rash-causing oil (urushiol) from your skin, and other contaminated areas, after exposure to poison ivy, poison oak and poison sumac plants. Our special cleanser can be used before the rash begins or as soon as possible after it surfaces to wash away oils that cause the rash, itching and spreading. When used within 8 hours of exposure to poisonous plants, Tecnu can remove poison oak and ivy oil before the rash begins. Use the cleanser to wash off the oil from items and help avoid a rash from secondary contact. In addition to removing rash-causing oils, the special soap can also be used to remove sap, pitch, grease and tar from skin. It is also highly effective to remove skunk odor from a dog or pet. title: Picolax Powder for Oral Solution Sodium PICOSULFATE, Magnesium Oxide Light, CITIRIC Acid. 2 X 16.1G SACHETS 2 Sachet Treatment - 1 Pack
bullet_point: [To empty the bowel before surgery or an examination such as colonoscopy or barium enema.]
description: Picolax sachets contain two active ingredients, sodium picosulfate and magnesium citrate, which are both laxatives.sodium picosulfate works by stimulating the nerve endings in the walls of the large intestine (colon) and rectum. This causes the muscles in the intestinal wall to contract more often and with increased force. When these muscles contract (a process known as peristalsis), this moves the contents of the intestine through the colon to the rectum so that the bowel can be emptied.sodium picosulfate is activated by the natural bacteria that are found in the colon, so it does not start working until it reaches this part of the gut. As sodium picosulfate increases the activity of the muscle in the bowel it can cause abdominal cramps.magnesium citrate acts as an 'osmotic laxative'. It works by causing water to be drawn into the lower bowel. This increases the water content and volume of the stools, making them softer and easier to pass.this combination of laxatives is used to cleanse the bowel prior to examination or surgical procedures that require the colon to be clean of stools, eg colonoscopy or barium enema. It is not used to treat constipation.picolax should be taken the day before your appointment. Follow the instructions given by your doctor. Two doses will be needed, one in the morning and one in the afternoon. The amount to take with each dose depends on age. This will be printed on the dispensing label that your pharmacist has put on the packet of medicine. If you are unsure about anything ask your doctor or pharmacist for advice.The usual dose for adults and children aged over nine years is one sachet in the morning and one sachet in the afternoon on the day before your procedure. The first sachet should be taken before 8am and the second sachet six to eight hours later.

What are you doing about that frequent heartburn? Yes, HEARTBURN – that burning and painful feeling in your throat or chest caused by refluxed stomach acid. Proton Pump Inhibitors, like HealthCareAisle Lansoprazole Delayed Release Capsules USP, 15 mg, stop acid production at the source - the pumps that release acid into the stomach. With just one capsule a day, you can treat frequent heartburn that occurs two or more days a week. Tips for Managing Heartburn: Avoid foods or drinks that are more likely to cause heartburn, such as rich, spicy, fatty and fried foods, chocolate, caffeine, alcohol and even some acidic fruits and vegetables. Eat slowly and do not eat big meals. Do not eat late at night or just before bedtime. Do not lie flat or bend over soon after eating. Raise the head of your bed. Wear loose-fitting clothing around your stomach. If you are overweight, lose weight. If you smoke, quit smoking. *This product is not manufactured or distributed by GSK Consumer Healthcare, distributor of Prevacid 24HR Capsules. Prevacid is a registered trademark of Takeda Pharmaceuticals North America, Inc.

Inhibidores de la bomba de protones, como HealthCareAisle Lansoprazole Cápsulas de liberación retardada USP, 15 mg, detienen la producción de ácido en la fuente - las bombas que liberan ácido en el estómago. Consejos para controlar la acidez estomacal: Evite los alimentos o bebidas que sean más propensos a causar acidez estomacal, como alimentos ricos, picantes, grasos y fritos, chocolate, cafeína, alcohol e incluso algunas frutas y verduras ácidas. Coma lentamente y no coma comidas grandes. No coma tarde en la noche o justo antes de acostarse. No se quede plano ni se doble poco después de comer. Levanta la cabeza de tu cama. Use ropa holgada alrededor de su estómago. Si tiene sobrepeso, pierda peso. description:
A family company since 1930
The Ricola brand was created by confectionery business Richterich & Compagnie in 1930 based on the twin pillars of innovation and quality awareness. The family company now exports its herb specialties to more than 50 countries around the world. As a pioneer in organic herb cultivation, Ricolas close ties with culture and architecture were established early on in the companys history. These ties are further reinforced through the two Ricola foundations and its own art collection.
Natural methods from Switzerland
We give our herbs the time they need to grow. But once they have been harvested, we have to work quickly. Because fresh herbs are sensitive, it is not good to keep them in transit for long periods of time. This is why we cultivate and process our herbs right here in Switzerland. The plants are sent to the Herb Center at our production site in Laufen, where they are dried, cleaned, cut, stored, and mixed. Next, the natural essences and active ingredients are extracted from the herbs and mixed together with all the other ingredients. This mixture is cooked, molded into drops and pearls, and left to cool. In other words, every single step of the production process takes place in Switzerland.

A Hera Venenosa Zanfel, Oak & Sumac Wash é uma solução tópica segura e eficaz para a reação causada pela exposição à hera venenosa, carvalho venenoso e açúcar. Quando usado corretamente, o Zanfel alivia a coceira e a dor causada pelo urushiol em cerca de 30 segundos.


Ao contrário da Zanfel, outros produtos reduzem temporariamente a coceira, mas não fazem nada para remover o urushiol. Zanfel remove urushiol ligando a ele para criar um agregado que pode ser lavado de forma rápida e eficaz com água. Zanfel pode ser usado a qualquer momento após a exposição. Zanfel pode ser aplicado em qualquer área externa do corpo, incluindo o rosto e os genitais, e é seguro para uso por crianças e mulheres grávidas ou amamentando. No caso de reações sistêmicas ou baseadas no sangue, geralmente são necessários esteroides de prescrição. Se você suspeita de uma reação sistêmica, consulte o seu médico imediatamente. Zanfel pode ser usado em conjunto com tratamentos de esteroides.


Zanfel trabalha ligando ao urushiol, criando um agregado agregado. Os aglomerados são facilmente lavados com água, permitindo que a área afetada comece a curar imediatamente.

1. Molhe a área afetada

2. Aperte 3,8 cm e 1,2 cm (não menos, veja a régua no pacote) de Zanfel em uma palma da mão. O produto não funcionará se for usado menos de 3,8 cm e 1,27 cm.

5. Enxágue a área completamente. Se a coceira voltar (o que pode durar várias horas depois), lave novamente, seguindo os passos de 1 a 5.
